description: Source code implementing Vulkan backend sum operations for tensors, including sum over dimensions and dimension lists, with integration into PyTorch's library system.

methods.name: sum_dim
methods.description: Performs sum reduction over a specific dimension of a Vulkan tensor, supporting keepdim and dtype options.

methods.name: sum_dim_IntList
methods.description: Performs sum reduction over a list of dimensions of a Vulkan tensor, with validation and normalization of dims.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of all elements in a tensor, or reduces over all dims if no specific dims are provided.
